## 🐛 Fixed

- **A damaged search index no longer stops the server.** When OpenCloud's bleve search index could not be opened, for example because one of its segment files was missing, the `search` service failed five times and took the whole server down with it (#31). The container now checks every index before OpenCloud starts and moves one that cannot be opened to `<name>.broken`, so OpenCloud starts with a new, empty index. It then indexes all spaces again in the background, and repeats an interrupted run on the next start.

## ⚡ Improved

- **Search is rebuilt after an index schema change.** When an image update switches OpenCloud to a new index format, for example OpenCloud 8 moving from `search/bleve` to `search/bleve-v5`, the new index is filled automatically instead of staying empty until someone runs `opencloud search index` by hand.
- README: the troubleshooting entry explains the new log lines and what to attach to a report, since the cause of the damage is still open.
